channel.title: Morning Digest News
channel.description: A look at AI doomsday scenarios that researchers say could put humanity at risk

item.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders unveils bill to ban artificial superintelligence and create Department of AI
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar are introducing legislation that would ban artificial superintelligence, pause development of advanced AI systems and create a new Department of Artificial Intelligence

item.title: US Justice Department charges Utah postal worker with dumping mail ballots in trash during primary
item.description: The Justice Department says a U.S. Postal Service letter carrier in Utah threw out more than 300 mail ballots that were being sent to voters for the state’s June primary

item.title: New York, California sue to block Trump administration deals canceling offshore wind projects
item.description: Democratic attorneys general from California and New York are suing the Trump administration over its plans to buy back offshore wind leases as it seeks to discourage expansion of wind energy in favor of fossil fuels

item.title: Hayden Panettiere died from an overdose involving fentanyl. She had just gone to rehab, coroner says
item.description: A coroner has determined that actor Hayden Panettiere died from an accidental overdose of several drugs including fentanyl

item.title: She lived to see ‘Deb’s law’ take effect. Now she can choose how she dies
item.description: Deb Robertson has become a leading advocate for end-of-life options in Illinois

item.title: Costa Rican man complained of lack of care for diabetes before his death in ICE custody, family says
item.description: A 36-year-old Costa Rican man whose family says he complained of not receiving proper care for his diabetes is the third detainee in less than six months to die at a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement facility in Louisiana

item.title: US futures inch higher and oil prices slip for 6th straight day after US and Iranian officials meet
item.description: U.S. futures are slightly higher after Wall Street held near its record and oil prices declined following U.S. President Donald Trump’s remarks that United States and Iranian officials had a meeting on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly

item.title: Rivian R2 vs. Tesla Model Y, an Edmunds electric SUV showdown
item.description: The Tesla Model Y has ruled the small electric SUV segment since it first hit the road, and the Rivian R2 is the newest challenger to its throne

item.title: Bill Clinton calls on leaders to fill gaps left by 'retreating governments'
item.description: Former President Bill Clinton opened this year’s Clinton Global Initiative conference, calling on attendees to promise to “step into the void created by retreating governments” following cuts by the United States and other nations to foreign assistance

item.title: Suspect in Yom Kippur shooting outside Ontario synagogue dies from his injuries
item.description: Authorities say a 29-year-old man suspected of opening fire on a police officer stationed outside an Ontario synagogue during Yom Kippur has died from his injuries

item.title: Russia pounds Kyiv with drones, killing 2 and wounding 23 hours before Zelenskyy’s UN address
item.description: Russia has launched daylight drone attacks on Kyiv, hours before Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was to address the U.N. General Assembly

item.title: A US military plane crashes near a US air base in Germany, injuring the pilot
item.description: An American military aircraft has crashed at a U.S. air base in western Germany, injuring the pilot

item.title: Polo off Mexican coast is among 'the strongest storms ever' as Odalys becomes a hurricane
item.description: Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades and is expected to skirt Mexico’s southwestern coast as a major hurricane

item.title: Worries about an AI internet takeover gain new urgency among doomsday scenarios
item.description: In a summer filled with revelations about artificial intelligence’s rapid development, researchers were especially alarmed by runaway bots finding their way onto the internet and, in at least one instance, coordinating there with one another

item.title: A look at AI doomsday scenarios that researchers say could put humanity at risk
item.description: Artificial intelligence researchers have warned for years of ways the technology could wipe out humanity: AI bots could design an unstoppable disease, unleash a nuclear war, or transform all of Earth into paper clip factories, as one thought experiment goes
